_nota: Narrator phrases (original texts of this project). If the value is a list, one is chosen at random. {nombre}, {rol}, {n} are replaced.
anochecer: Night falls over the village. Everyone closes their eyes and stays silent.
Night covers the village. Close your eyes and let nobody make a sound.

lobos.despertar: Werewolves, wake up. Choose your victim on your phones. You must all agree.

cupido.despertar: Archer, wake up. Choose the two lovers on your phone.

vidente.despertar: Seer, wake up. Choose whom you want to discover.

enamorados.despertar: Lovers, wake up. Look at your phones and recognise each other.

dos_hermanas.despertar: The Whispers, wake up and recognise each other.

tres_hermanos.despertar: The Brotherhood, wake up and recognise each other.

protector.despertar: Guardian, wake up. Choose whom you protect tonight.

bruja.despertar: Alchemist, wake up. See who has been attacked and decide whether you use your potions.

comediante.despertar: Jester, wake up. If you want, choose one of the characters you can play tonight.

zorro.despertar: Fox, wake up. If you want, point to whom you will sniff.

juez.despertar: Judge, wake up. Look on your phone at how your power works.

nino_salvaje.despertar: Wild Child, wake up. Choose your mentor.
nino_salvaje.dormir: Wild Child, go back to sleep.

domador.despertar: Beast Tamer, wake up. Look at your phone.

perro_lobo.despertar: Dual Nature, wake up. Loyal hound or wild wolf? Decide on your phone.
perro_lobo.dormir: Dual Nature, go back to sleep.

albino.despertar: Moon Wolf, wake up on your own. You can eliminate a Werewolf.
albino.dormir: Moon Wolf, go back to sleep.

infecto.despertar: Corruptor, wake up. Do you want to corrupt the victim?

feroz.despertar: Dire Wolf, wake up. Are you hungry for a second victim?
feroz.dormir: Dire Wolf, go back to sleep.

flautista.despertar: Shadow Piper, wake up. Choose whom to enchant tonight.
flautista.dormir: Shadow Piper, go back to sleep.

hechizados.despertar: The enchanted, wake up. Look at your phones and recognise each other.
hechizados.dormir: Enchanted ones, go back to sleep.

amanecer: The first rays of sun light up the village. Everyone wakes up and opens their eyes.
amanecerSinMuertos: Nobody died tonight. The village breathes a sigh of relief… for now.
A miracle: there are no victims tonight.
amanecerConMuertos: But something terrible has happened during the night…

muerte.pena: {nombre} dies of grief: they cannot live without {de}.
muerte.oxido: {nombre} has been found dead: the Knight's sword gave them a deadly disease.

lobo: One wolf fewer! Let the village celebrate!
Well done, villagers! That fur will scare nobody any more.
Awoo… it is over! A Werewolf falls.
aldeaPoder: What a loss! The village is left without {rol}.
There are tears in the village: {rol} is gone.
aldea: One innocent fewer. The wolves lick their lips.
Rest in peace. They were one of us.
otro: The mystery grows in the village.

debate: Let the debate begin. Which of you is a Werewolf?
votacion: The debate is over. Vote on your phone for whoever you want to lynch.
empate: A tie! Nobody will be lynched today.
nadieVota: Nobody has voted. Nobody is lynched today.

victoria.aldea: The village has won! All the Werewolves have been eliminated.
victoria.lobos: The Werewolves have won! The village has fallen into darkness.
victoria.nadie: Nobody is left alive. Nobody wins.
victoria.enamorados: The lovers have won! Their love has survived everything.
victoria.angel: The Divine Angel has won! They have gone back to heaven in the first vote.
victoria.flautista: The Shadow Piper has won! The whole village dances, enchanted by the music.
victoria.albino: The Moon Wolf has won! They are the last survivor of the village.
victoria.sectario: The Cultist has won! The other group has been wiped out.

alguacil: Before the debate, choose the Sheriff on your phones. Their vote will count double.
sucesor: {nombre} was the Sheriff. With their last breath, they appoint their successor.
cazador: {nombre} was the Hunter! Before dying, they shoot someone from their phone.
cazadorNoDispara: The Hunter did not get to shoot.
chivo: A tie! And, as always, the Scapegoat pays.
chivoElige: Before leaving, the Scapegoat decides who may vote in the next vote.
votantesElegidos: In the next vote only these will vote: {nombres}.
indultoTonto: Wait a moment! {nombre} is the Village Fool. Ashamed, they spare their life, but they will never be able to vote again.
aldeaSinPoderes: The village has killed its Elder! Devastated, all the villagers lose their powers.
reglas: Let me tell you the basics. Every night, the wolves secretly choose a victim. Every day, the village debates and votes to eliminate a suspect. The villagers win if they eliminate all the wolves; the wolves win if they finish off all the villagers. Each of you has a secret role on your phone. Good luck, and do not let them fool you.
comedianteCartas: The Jester will be able to play these characters: {cartas}.
sectarioGrupos: Among you hides the Cultist. The village is split into two groups. Sun group: {sol}. Moon group: {luna}.
angelPrimerDia: A Divine Angel has come down to the village. Before the first night, everyone gathers to debate and vote.
debateAngel: Let the debate begin. Which of you deserves to be the first to leave?
segundaVotacion: The Judge has decided there will be a second vote! Vote again, with no debate.
linchamientoDecidido: The village has decided to lynch {nombre}. But before revealing their card…
sirvienta: Handmaiden: if you want to take {nombre}'s place, now is the moment.
sirvientaRevela: Wait a moment! {sirvienta} was the Handmaiden and sacrifices themselves for {nombre}: they secretly take their place.
gruñido: Grrrr! The Beast Tamer's bear growls: a Werewolf is sitting next to them.
The bear growls! There is a wolf next to the Beast Tamer.
saltoDebate: The village has already decided. Let us move on to the vote.
reparto: Look at your phones: your secret card is there. Memorise it, let nobody see it, and press Ready.
